description: Cancel answers with the row's CURRENT truth after the request (S64 T3): a queued worker reads cancelled outright (no goroutine ever ran — the manager wrote the ending); a running one reads running WITH cancelRequested, because its own goroutine owns the terminal write and the event carries the ending a moment later. Cancel is the family's only write — it names a row the caller can already see, never a Go function to fire, which is why no asyncworkers.start exists and never will.
